sql: select x.scenario_key, (select string_agg((c->>'id') || ': ' || left(c->>'note', 400), ' / ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.checks) c where c->>'ok' = 'false') as falhas, (select string_agg('[' || (e->>'turn') || '] ' || (e->>'who') || ': ' || left(replace(e->>'text', E'\n', ' '), case when e->>'who' = 'ferramenta' then 900 else 600 end), ' ## ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.transcript) e where coalesce(e->>'kind','') not in ('image','video','document','legenda')) as t from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = '892f992d-346b-4906-856e-bad657456ace' and x.status <> 'passed'
